Anna Tsivileva: level of medical care provided to Russian servicemen meets the highest global standards
The fifth Scientific and Practical Forum on Surgery of Armed Conflicts ‘Gunshot wound. Surgery of injuries’ has been started in Moscow. Leading doctors of the Ministry of Defence and the Ministry of Health, along with specialists from 16 countries, have gathered at the venue.
💬
State Secretary — Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Anna Tsivileva, speaking at the ceremonial opening of the International scientific and practical forum, noted that
the level of medical care provided to Russian service members meets the highest global standards.
‘The current level of medical care provided to servicemen and civilian population fully meets the highest global standards’, said Anna Tsivileva.
▫️
The Deputy Head of the Russian Military Department also noted that
during the special military operation, the system of providing care to the wounded has undergone comprehensive modernisation.
To maintain and further raise this standard, Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov ordered to initiate a large-scale project entitled ‘Military Medicine of the Future’, aimed at comprehensive improvement of the quality of medical care at all stages – from the frontline to restorative treatment and rehabilitation.
🏥
In addition,
a programme to establish modern high-tech prosthetics centres is being actively implemented
in all regions of Russia.
‘All the necessary conditions have been created in the country's military hospitals for performing the most complex reconstructive operations
using additive manufacturing and tissue engineering methods. Russian science today demonstrates a high level of professionalism, which is confirmed by the scale and depth of fundamental research conducted at the country's leading research institutions’, said the deputy head of the Russian military department.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

Strikes have been delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades and one assault brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and one national guard brigade near Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Druzhovka, Nikolayevka, and Toretskoye (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 180 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, one artillery gun, and 28 motor vehicles. 📍 The Tsentr Group's units continue
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30680

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
↗️
The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
In Kharkov region, strikes have been delivered at manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades and two assault regiments of the AFU close to Katerinovka, Podsredneye, Malinovka, Ploskoye, Chuguyev, and Turovo.
💥
In Sumy region,
formations of two mechanised and one airmobile brigades of the AFU
have been neutralised
close to Yastrebinoye, Krovnoye, Vakalovshchina, and Vyazovoye.
▪️
The enemy lost more than 110 troops and seven motor vehicles.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Russian elements have inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade near Peski-Radkovskiye, Studenok, Monachinovka, Smorodkovka, and Nechvolodovka (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to over 210 troops, one field artillery gun, and 16 motor vehicles.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes have been delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades and one assault brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and one national guard brigade near Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Druzhovka, Nikolayevka, and Toretskoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 180 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, one artillery gun, and 28 motor vehicles.
📍
The Tsentr Group's units continued to carry out intensive offensive operations.
Russian units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades close to Verovka, Samarskoye, Kuritsino, Novokrivorozhye, Kalinino, Starorayskoye, Kamenka, and Belozerskoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU formations have lost more than 340 troops, seven armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence.
The Group's elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one air assault brigade, one assault brigade of the AFU near Novotroitskoye (Zaporozhye region), Podgavrilovka, Kolomiytsy, Ivanovka, and Kirichkovo (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU lost up to 210 troops and five motor vehicles.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
Formations of one mechanised brigade and one mountain assault brigade of the AFU have been hit close to Kirovo, Kamyshevakha, and Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 15 troops and 17 motor vehicles have been neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered strikes at
power and transport infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the AFU, military airfields, production and storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles and ground robotic systems, ammunition depots, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed forces in 148 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
eight Neptune long-range guided missiles and 268 fixed-wing UAVs.
📊
In total,
since the beginning of the special military operation,
the enemy has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
293,399
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
31,700
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,797
MLRS fighting vehicles,
▫️
36,957
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
77,613
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫️ Thank you for your service and feats Today, the Missile Troops and Artillery Day is celebrated in the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation.
item.description: Thank you for your service and feats ▫️ 📆 Today, the Missile Troops and Artillery Day is celebrated in the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation. 💬 Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov congratulated the servicemen and veterans , noting that artillerymen and missilemen have written many bright pages into the history of our great power. ‘Today, the personnel of the Missile Troops and Artillery selflessly perform their military duty, effectively carry out responsible tasks to deliver fire damage to the enemy, destroy its equipment and manpower, conduct counter-battery warfare, and make an invaluable contribution to strengthening the country's defence capability during the special military operation’. ▫️ Andrei Belousov expressed confidence that ‘in the future, the servicemen of the Missile Troops and Artillery will continue to raise their professional level, successfully master new models of weapons and equipment, and reliably ensure the sovereignty and strategic security of the state’. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
